comparison.scope: Bounded atomic-weight comparison, not global first atomism.

baseline.research_scope: Dalton’s relative-atomic-weight and combination framework with bounded early reception.

cases.comparison_subject: The early-1800s framework relating proposed relative atomic weights to general rules for compounds, including Thomson’s conditional 1807 application and Dalton’s 1808 account.

candidate_evidence.locator: Printed pp. 212–216: relative weights and combination rules.
Printed p. 96: Wollaston’s recognition of the relation.
Reprint pp. 42–46: 1807 Thomson conditional exposition and numerical illustration.

comparators.configuration: Higgins’s 1789 ultimate-particle models, including successive 1:2 through 1:5 combinations

evidence.locator: Printed pp. 12–15 and 132–135; source PDF pp. 34–37 and 154–157.

comparators.contrast: Higgins’s inspected pages already model several small-whole-number particle combinations. The Dalton and Thomson texts give a program for inferring relative atomic weights from composition by mass; the Higgins excerpt does not establish whether a systematic weight table exists elsewhere in his book.

comparators.configuration: Earlier chemical combining proportions attributed by Thomson in 1813 to J. B. Richter

evidence.locator: Reprinted July 1813 article p. 32 / source PDF p. 44.

comparators.contrast: Thomson credits Richter with an earlier conception of definite proportions while criticizing his determination methods. The original Richter work was not independently inspected, and this attribution alone does not establish Dalton’s priority over all stoichiometric research.

comparators.configuration: Proust’s 1799 fixed composition by mass for copper carbonate

evidence.locator: Translated excerpt: On Carbonate of Copper; On Native Carbonate of Copper.

comparators.contrast: Proust’s work already asserted fixed component proportions by mass. The inspected passages do not themselves establish Dalton’s later general relative-atomic-weight model. The original French paper was not inspected.

cases.limits: Earlier atomism, fixed mass proportions and successive small-integer particle combinations are documented. The narrowly compared contribution is a quantitative relative-atomic-weight inference, not those ingredients individually or a universal first proof. The 1804 selected recognition is retrospective; earlier reception remains possible.
